# AI Output Review Checklist

- [ ] Output followed active spec.
- [ ] Output did not alter unrelated behavior.
- [ ] Output did not invent undocumented requirements.
- [ ] Output respected architecture invariants.
- [ ] Output did not add unapproved dependencies.
- [ ] Output did not weaken auth, validation, access control, or data handling.
- [ ] Tests or verification steps are included.
- [ ] Progress tracker and relevant docs were updated.
